annotations.title: Give someone a tap on the back

description: Sends a tap on the back: a short buzz on the person's phone, with the sender's name if signed in (or a first name they give). In the day after a finish it arrives as a congratulation. Use it only when the user explicitly asks to give someone a tap on the back; one tap per request. Inputs: person (an id from find_person), or a livedot handle or follow link; or tour (the tap goes to the tour's organiser on its days); or club with event (one tap to each member on the club's live map who accepts taps). Side effects: sends a notification to the person (or to each club member, and it reports how many). Limits: follows each person's own settings; if taps are off, they aren't live, or they only accept taps from people with their link, it sends nothing and says so. Returns the live map.

club.description: A club or team, by its name or page address, or the club id a club card gave ("runfast:demo"): one tap to each of its members on the map.

coach.description: A coach, or the coach id a team card gave ("runfast:coach-nadia-pillay"): one tap to each of their athletes on the map.

code.description: A follow link or its code (windline.tech/f/<code>, runfast.tech/f/<code>).

event.description: With club or coach: the race they are in, if named.

name.description: The first name the user wants on the tap ("Sam"), if they gave one. A signed-in user's tap shows their own public name instead.

person.description: A person id from find_person, e.g. "runfast:p:pdemo00megan" or "h:megan".

tour.description: A Windline tour, by its name, address or organiser ("Alistair's Durban tour"): the tap goes to the tour's organiser, who reads them out at night.

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

name: tap_on_the_back

outputSchema.description: The tap, and their live answer (or, for a tour, who reads it out).

ahead.description: The next stretches of the course: from_km, to_km, at (ISO), temp_c, effect, along_road_kmh, wind_kmh (running: heat_stress).

can_tap.description: A tap on the back would reach them now (taps on; live or in the day after the finish; this asker may tap).

can_tap_team.description: A team tap would reach at least one of them now.

capped.description: Several matches: true when there are more than the count shows.

club.description: The club: name, app (windline or runfast), slug, url (its page).

clubs.description: Several clubs matched: name, app, people. Ask which one.

conditions.description: The weather where they are: temp_c, feels_c, wind_kmh, gust_kmh, wind_from_deg, along_road_kmh, effect (head, tail, cross, calm), rain_mm_h.

count.description: How many of the club's people are on its live map in that race.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

eta.description: The finish time their pace points to: at (ISO), local, tz.

finished.description: They'd finished: it landed as a congratulation.

finished_count.description: How many of them have finished.

goal.description: Their goal time and how far behind (positive) or ahead (negative) of it they are, in seconds.

id.description: The person id to pass to where_is ("h:<handle>", "<app>:f:<code>" or "<app>:p:<id>").

members.description: Each member on the club's live map (Findable): id (for where_is), name, photo, status, sub (km and goal delta, or the finish time), km (null near the start or finish), goal_delta, can_tap.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

name.description: Their name as the public live page shows it.

on_course.description: How many are on the course.

pace.description: Running: per_km_s; cycling: kmh; with words.

people.description: Several matches: the 5 most likely, each with id, name, sport, race, status, where, pace, goal, bib, club. Ask the user to pick; never guess.

photo.description: Their profile picture (from windline.tech or runfast.tech), only for someone shown by their full name (Findable).

position.description: Only when the public live page shows where they are: km, mile, of_km, percent, seen (ISO time).

race.description: The race (or ride) its members are in.

road_ahead.description: The Windline forecast engine's rating of the road ahead: rating (good, fair, tough), why.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

status.description: live, delayed, nosignal, paused, waiting, finished or stopped.

taps.description: Their taps so far, with this one.

taps_sent.description: A team tap: how many members got one.

team.description: A team tap: the club's name. A person's tap: their club and coach, as where_is.

total.description: Several matches: how many ("24", or "20+" when capped).

tour.description: A tour's tap: the tour (the tap went to its organiser).

units.description: The units the text answer uses.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Give someone a tap on the back
